review: Independent related-film discovery progress, retry fairness and natural-warming observability
candidate: Main-agent first-pair rotation patch on top of baseline; planned CE2034, not device-verified by this reviewer

scope.method: Read production source and retained sanitized directory evidence. Execute production functions with in-memory cache/provider fixtures and controlled time; main agent alone implements fixes.

retained_device_evidence.actual_gui_focus: A different TV work, not Madoka; the displayed directory still contained 21 catalogue items
retained_device_evidence.interpretation: This proves a partial forced directory result, not a Madoka natural-focus warm attempt. A second directory RPC would itself run preparation and change caches, so it cannot isolate natural background progress. The 8-second preparation budget also excludes preceding foreground detail acquisition, so 11.299 seconds alone is not a budget violation.

baseline_progress_findings.conclusion: Partial retries normally progress through successful detail/page caches, but persistent slow failures at the start of a stable sorted candidate list can starve a later candidate. The first Madoka result alone does not establish which mechanism occurred on the device.
baseline_progress_findings.healthy_confirmed_prefix: Real discover/load + tmdb_get + movie_details_guard: first pass retains 152042/152044 at 8 seconds; next pass performs network work only for 212162 and completes in 4 seconds.
baseline_progress_findings.healthy_unrelated_prefix: Valid but non-associated movie details are also cached. A following pass hits those canonical detail entries and can reach 212162 without repeating their network work.
baseline_progress_findings.search_page_progress: With three search pages, successful pages 1/2 are cached before page 3 times out. The next pass requests only page 3 and completes search/details in 5 seconds. Lack of a page cursor is not by itself a no-progress proof.

persistent_failure_counterexample.result: Every pass exhausts the remaining budget before 212162 completes. The 20-second failure marker has expired before the next 60-second warm retry. Existing successful movies remain; complete remains false.
persistent_failure_counterexample.boundary: IDs 100/101 and their timing are synthetic. No evidence yet identifies these or equivalent blocking candidates in the device's Madoka search results.

source_points: related_movies.py:293-302 baseline sorted candidates and start-at-zero pairs
related_movies.py:283 preserves confirmed movies but does not change scheduling

rotation_review.rejected_first_candidate: Recording the last submitted pair did not fix the original tail case. 212162 was submitted with only one second left, timed out, and became the cursor. Rotating after the final ID wrapped to the same slow prefix. Three repeated attempts still lacked 212162.
rotation_review.current_rule: On partial passes advance after the first submitted pair only. This rotates which candidates receive the initial full budget, while every current candidate still needs validation before complete=true.

real_cache_tail_recheck.method: Fixed .venv-closure interpreter; real discover/load, AST-extracted real tmdb_get, real movie_details_guard, in-memory TTL cache, real two-worker concurrency and controlled accelerated clock. No network or device calls.
real_cache_tail_recheck.recovery: After the failed prefix was changed to valid but unrelated detail responses, the fourth pass remained partial. Only the fifth pass, after all current candidates were validated, became complete=true and cleared detail_after.
real_cache_tail_recheck.controls: Healthy successful and valid-but-unrelated prefix caches still let the next pass fetch only 212162 and complete. The pagination control still fetched only previously unfinished page 3 plus 212162 on the next pass.
real_cache_tail_recheck.conclusion: The first-pair rotation blocks the reproduced stable slow-prefix and budget-truncated-tail starvation paths without dropping established movies or treating partial validation as complete. Persistent provider failures can still prevent completeness, as intended.

independent_in_memory_boundary_results.invalid_cursor_behavior: Ignored as a scheduling hint; each case validates all five current IDs exactly once and only then returns complete=true with cursor cleared.
independent_in_memory_boundary_results.valid_cursor_22: First pair becomes 33/44; all five IDs still validated before complete.
independent_in_memory_boundary_results.cursor_at_last_id_55: Wraps correctly to 11/22; all five IDs still validated.
independent_in_memory_boundary_results.partial_preservation: A failed ID 22 keeps complete=false and retains previously verified ID 99 together with newly verified current IDs. Cursor is only a scheduling hint, not association evidence.
independent_in_memory_boundary_results.cancellation: Real load with cancellation during detail fetch performs zero cache writes, retaining the old cursor and previously verified list.

rotation_review.independent_pytest: test_anime_navigation_hub.py + test_navigation_preparation.py: 77 passed; -B and cacheprovider disabled

natural_warmer_schedule.meaning: An incomplete or cancelled work item gets a 60-second cooldown from attempt start, not a one-hour success cooldown. Resource/playback/dialog gates can postpone or cancel any attempt.
natural_warmer_schedule.important_limit: Waiting on the incomplete/retry card does not schedule this TV work. Waiting on one of its film cards warms that film, not the parent TV-to-film discovery. Background completion does not refresh the browsing directory automatically.
natural_warmer_schedule.logging: utils/kodi/utils.py imports utils/kodi/logging.py. Its unspecified non-error log level is DEBUG, so Navigation warm/preparation completion lines may be absent under ordinary logging. Absence is not proof of no work.

minimal_readonly_device_probe_plan.operator: Main agent only; no device actions were performed for this review
sampling: Before natural observation, resolve the existing plugin profile/database without importing lib.db.cached or constructing PickleDatabase. Record active player/dialog/window state and safely parse only action/public target ID/season from the focused item's URL.

For focus warming, use the Madoka show card or first-season card and leave it stable, without Files.GetDirectory, load, prepare, forced warm or cache clearing during the approximately 130-second observation. Take fresh read-only snapshots before and after possible minute-spaced attempts.

For recent warming, use a Home control with no parseable work target, retain idle>=12 seconds and read the actual unfinished recent-target list. Otherwise eligible focused work has priority and confounds attribution. Observe only up to the existing three-target policy.

Compare allowed cache row existence, expiry, blob digest, decoded related IDs/complete/cursor and cache revision across snapshots. A newly written public metadata row is evidence of real cache work; an unchanged row or already-warm fixture is inconclusive, not failure or pass. After recording the natural cache state, opening the UI is a separate display check because it may perform fresh preparation.

sqlite.location: special://profile/addon_data/plugin.video.bobbi/<ADDON_ID>.cached.sqlite; normal plugin service uses plugin.video.bobbi.cached.sqlite. Resolve the existing file before opening.
sqlite.open: sqlite3 URI mode=ro, uri=True; PRAGMA query_only=ON; no immutable=1 because live WAL must be observed. Use a new short read transaction/connection for each snapshot, then close.
sqlite.tables: cached(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, data BLOB NOT NULL, expires TIMESTAMP NOT NULL); cache_revision(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, identity TEXT, revision INTEGER), singleton=1
sqlite.time_caveat: Partial discovery retains the previous payload time even when more movies are added. Compare blob digest/IDs and row expiry, not payload time alone.
other_allowed_keys: am6b_details283| + json.dumps(['season_details', {'id':39218,'season':1,'language':locale,'append_to_response':''}, locale], sort_keys=True), locale in zh-CN/zh-TW/en-US
search_movie|<Python dict string of query and page>|<language>, only for validated public show aliases and explicitly selected page numbers
sqlite.safe_decode: The related-film result is plain data after plain(fetch), so reject executable pickle opcodes GLOBAL/STACK_GLOBAL/REDUCE/BUILD/INST/OBJ/NEWOBJ/NEWOBJ_EX/EXT1/EXT2/EXT4/PERSID/BINPERSID, use an Unpickler whose find_class and persistent_load always reject, and bound blob size, opcode count, recursion and graph nodes. Validate expected schema and only output whitelisted scalar fields. Do not call unrestricted pickle.loads on arbitrary database rows. Other AsObj detail records can be observed by existence/expiry/digest without decoding or importing their product classes.
sqlite.privacy: No arbitrary key enumeration, raw payload, title history, private URL, token or cookie output. Query keys are parameter-bound and derived from explicitly selected public identities.

minimal_readonly_device_probe_plan.recent_history: The source is the existing profile database.pickle jt:lfh dictionary, not a SQLite history table. Read at most the product's 64MiB limit through the same data-only decoder, apply production-equivalent history_rows/parse_time rules, inspect first ten eligible rows, deduplicate public target tuples and take three. Do not instantiate the product DB class or import last_files/general.utils (those initialize unrelated state); do not print history payloads.

attribution_limit: No physical evidence yet proves that Madoka's missing 212162 was caused by prefix starvation rather than no natural warm attempt, budget timing, provider search coverage, candidate/association filtering, cancellation or missing cache state. Do not rewrite the retained incomplete result as complete.
